proposed_university_row.name: Galatasaray University
proposed_university_row.website_url_note: Verified live 2026-09-01: https://gsu.edu.tr (no www) resolves 200 with a valid Sectigo-issued cert, subject O=GALATASARAY UNIVERSITESI. https://www.gsu.edu.tr (www subdomain) fails TLS chain verification in every tool tried (curl, WebFetch, browser) -- likely an incomplete intermediate-certificate chain served on that specific vhost, not a fake/wrong domain (the leaf cert itself is genuine and correctly issued). Recommend storing the bare domain as canonical; flag the www-subdomain cert gap for whoever owns gsu.edu.tr's own infrastructure, not something to route around here.

proposed_university_programs.name: İletişim (Fransızca) (KKTC Uyruklu)
proposed_university_programs.note: 1-seat Northern Cyprus national quota variant of the base İletişim programme, not a distinct field

programs_source.source_type: official_primary (national ÖSYM/YÖK placement guide, keyless public API)
programs_source.note: All 13 of Galatasaray's LISANS-level programmes are French-medium (ogrenimDiliAdi='Fransızca') -- a defining, distinguishing characteristic of this institution among Turkey's state universities, not an incidental fact. No English-medium or Turkish-medium LISANS track exists at Galatasaray per this live data.

placement_cycles_note: cycle_label/source_url/data_confidence/retrieved_at intentionally omitted here (same fields as programs_source above) -- an --apply run would populate them exactly as scripts/ingest-yok-atlas-placements.ts already does for the other 12 universities, via the same matching path, once these program rows exist to match against.

domestic_admission_facts.mechanism: Identical to every other Turkish devlet/vakif university: YKS placement in strict rank order per programme quota. No essay, interview, recommendation letter, or activity file at any point -- lib/admissions/system-shape.ts's existing Turkey/domestic entry already covers this correctly; nothing Galatasaray-specific needed here.
domestic_admission_facts.distinguishing_fact: Every programme is French-medium. What is NOT established: whether placed students who don't already speak French complete a mandatory prep year before the 4-year programme begins. gsu.edu.tr references a general 'Yabancı Dil Eğitimi' (foreign language education) unit but no page found describes a French-specific placement/prep pathway for newly-admitted students. Left unresolved rather than guessed -- see the handoff doc.

international_pathway_facts.exam_name: GSÜYÖS (Galatasaray Üniversitesi Yabancı Uyruklu Öğrenci Sınavı -- Galatasaray University Foreign National Student Exam)
international_pathway_facts.note: Galatasaray runs its own named foreign-national entrance exam rather than accepting SAT/A-Level/IB/Abitur/diploma-score directly the way lib/admissions/system-shape.ts's general Turkey/international entry describes some universities doing -- a genuine per-institution variation within that entry's own framing, not a contradiction of it.

cited_deadline.source_quote_fr: La deuxième session de l'appel à candidatures 2026-2027 pour les programmes de licence destinés aux étudiants internationaux aura lieu du 1er au 4 septembre 2026.
cited_deadline.applies_to: international/foreign-national undergraduate applicants only -- NOT the domestic YKS calendar, which is nationally set by ÖSYM and not Galatasaray-specific

explicitly_not_established: Whether a mandatory French-language preparatory year exists for domestically-placed (YKS) students
GSÜYÖS's own specific credential requirements, scoring, or test format
